description: University Grants Commission - Amendment to the Postgraduate Institute of Science Ordinance
categorisation: This gazette content contains an ordinance made by the University Grants Commission amending the Postgraduate Institute of Science Ordinance. It involves legal amendments to existing legislation (Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978) and regulatory changes to academic programs, which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) rather than government personnel/structure categories.
